scope: 50 new instrumental lullaby and gentle miniature leads beyond earlier classical/Commons and Bandcamp searches.
rightsNote: Compatible recording licenses are declared by the linked sources. LicenseReviewStatus remains unchecked until the complete recording-specific admission review; no track is promoted.
listeningNote: One maintainer listening favorite is retained; four rejected recordings are excluded from the active shortlist and preserved as rejected audit records. Full admission checks remain pending for the favorite and all unreviewed candidates.

deduplication.note: Three separately titled recordings share one author package page; alternate encodings and short edits were not counted as additional works.
